power_stage.topology: dual active bridge, two full bridges of 2 paralleled TO-247-4 SiC MOSFETs per switch position (8 per bridge) on ceramic insulators on the earthed cold plate
power_stage.modulation: SPS near V1 = n*V2 and at heavy load; EPS/DPS/TPS from an offline LUT (a1, a2, phi vs V1, V2, P) elsewhere - see efficiency_map.csv columns a1/a2

dead_time.mode: hardware shoot-through guard (fixed window, worst case used in every loss figure) + firmware LUT on top (predicted ZVS transition + 20 ns, 50-300 ns)
dead_time.note: DR-02 decision: the hardware guard owns the minimum, firmware owns the rest; the drawn GDRV stretcher (104-354 ns) must be replaced by a 69-188 ns gate-level window
dead_time.lut_rule: dead time = t_d(off)(RG_off) - t_d(on) + predicted ZVS transition + 20 ns; RG_off 0.27 ohm adds ~3.5 ns of t_d(off) (DS Fig. 28)
dead_time.hw_guard_basis: min = t_d(off) 62 ns + t_f 15 ns (hot, design R_G,off) - t_d(on) 28 ns + 20 ns; logic-side delay element +/-15 % plus the NSI6651 delay mismatch 40 ns on both ends

hard_switching.rule: no hard turn-on at >= 800 V: TPS LUT keeps ZVS; firmware blocks SPS below the LUT's ZVS boundary and checks the LUT integrity at start; the decks overstate the overshoot (~1.5x on the GM4) - DPT on the real layout with R_G,on is a release condition

paralleling.rule: hottest device RMS <= 90 % of its lead rating (106 A)
paralleling.layout: each device its own R_G,on / R_G,off and Kelvin source return; Miller clamp per device (PNP follower as D-028); matched V_th bin recommended (sharing factor assumes none)

gate_drive.driver: NOVOSENSE NSI6651ASC-DSWR industrial grade (one per switch position, 8 total; D-035). The -Q1 grade fails the DESAT and dead-time budgets below (I_STO 100 mA min, t_pd 40-130 ns)
gate_drive.bias: TI UCC14241-Q1 isolated, 24 V input, regulated +18/-3.5 V (VDD-VEE 21.5 V, COM-VEE 3.5 V, both in its 18-25 V / >= 2.5 V range), reinforced 1414 V DC (D-016)
gate_drive.RG_note: per device: R_G,off 1.5 ohm = smallest E24 value keeping the NSI6651 sink <= 10 A at VDD-VEE 21.78 V, ROL 0.3 ohm, R_G,int 2.3 ohm (lowest maker) and -1 % resistor; R_G,on 2 ohm (hard-switched edges only; ZVS edges are not affected)

desat.response_basis: NSI6651 industrial: LEB 200 ns (+25 %) + C_pin 15 pF x 9.8 V / 430 uA + deglitch 265 + DESAT->OUT 300 ns + soft turn-off to the plateau at 0.25 A
desat.t_sc_basis: ASSUMPTION per device (no Chinese maker publishes one): {'IV3Q12013T4Z': 2e-06, 'SG2M014120LJ': 2e-06} us at <= 800 V / 25 C start, x 800/1000 x 0.7 for 1000 V / 150 C; ROHM SCT4018KR, the only Asian part with a rating, states 4.0 us typ at 18 V / 800 V (p3)
desat.note: UCC21710 OC pin 0.7 V (p9) with external DESAT network (p27); 7 V = ~340 A at Tj 150 C; short-circuit withstand of GM4 not published -> confirm by SC test
desat.residual_risk: withstand unknown for both makers; a short-circuit test on samples at 950 V / 150 C is a release condition, and the makers must supply t_SC

dc_link_snubber_hf.note: port 1 caps must be >= 1.5 kV for 950 V + overshoot; CRD used 2 kV. Resistors: pulse-rated thick film, wide-terminal 2512 with a thermal path to the plane. Values keep the simulated CRD-equivalent network (R/n, n*C); nearest standard parts 13.7 ohm (E96) and 1.1 nF (E24) change it by < 1 %
dc_link_snubber_hf.hf_caps_per_bridge: 20 x 47 nF C0G >= 1.2 kV (3640) KEMET KC-LINK CKC33C473KEGACAUTO across DC+/DC- at the switch positions, spread over the two legs
dc_link_snubber_hf.ring_down_rule: each bridge commutation reverses its DC current (dI = 2 I_sw in SPS, I_sw per leg in TPS); 0.5 L_bus dI^2 rings down in the terminal network twice per period (P = f L_bus sum dI^2), shared by RC resistors (5 % worst simulated), HF-cap ESR, film-bank ESR and copper
dc_link_snubber_hf.L_bus_target_nH: design <= 7.2 (DS Fig. 19 basis; all numbers here use 7.2); every nH less cuts the ring-down power proportionally - measure by DPT

hf_caps.rule: <= 70 % of the typical 13 A rms (1 MHz, heatsinked) of the KC-LINK curve (docs/datasheets/passives-capacitors/KEMET-KC-LINK.pdf p2, p3, p5, p6); ESR 5 mOhm / ESL 1.0 nH per part ASSUMED

I1_dc.sensor: LEM HO 120-NP class (+/-300 A, as CRD)

I_xfmr.note: DC-coupled (flux balance); LEM HOB 130-P meets range and bandwidth (+/-250 A, 1 MHz, t_D90 <= 200 ns, HOB-P p9); HO 120-NP (CRD) at 350 kHz/2.5 us would not
I_xfmr.range_check: +/-250 A covers: peak operating 169 A, transients in dab_control up to 174 A with the split phase update (a naive phase step would add ~47 A), the OC trip 210 A with its 200-220 A tolerance (220/250 = 88 % of range) - required range >= 1.1 x 220 = 242 A

protection.I_xfmr_oc_trip_vs_V: min(200 A, I where V_bus,max + dV(I) = 1150 V, dV from DS Fig. 19) for the higher-voltage bridge
protection.v1_above_900V: power limited by derating map (switching SOA)
protection.I_xfmr_oc_vdep_implementation: NOT on the CTRL CMPSS: AN1 passes the AMC3330 (1.6-2.6 us) and acts after the local trip. The local hardware window is the only fast OC protection; with soft turn-off its level need not depend on the bus voltage (overshoot 33 V)

local_ov_board.verdict: DC: inside the module 1200 V and both capacitor banks (port 1 1300 V class, port 2 1074 V allowed at its hot spot). Switching: while the bus is above ~950 V the turn-off SOA allows only 110 A (port 1 at 1048 V) vs up to 113 A at full load, so the firmware OV (960/920 V) must set the phase to zero within one switching period (cycle-by-cycle via CMPSS/trip zone) - the 63 us hardware path is the backup only

trip_turn_off.mechanism: every hardware trip (local OC window, port OV, DC flux, +24V UV, driver RDY/UVLO, cross-trip from the other bridge, over-temperature) injects into the DESAT pin of all 8 NSI6651 drivers (diode-OR, >= 10 V from each driver's own VCC2 through a switch referenced to that driver's GND2: one isolated trip channel per driver, reinforced like the driver itself), so every switch turns off through the driver soft turn-off (I_STO >= 0.25 A, industrial grade). RST/EN low alone is a normal fast turn-off (NSI datasheet p28) and is used only AFTER the soft turn-off, >= 3 us later, to latch the state
trip_turn_off.inductor_note: series inductor saturates at about 381 A (0.41 T, 100 C) against a fault peak of 576 A: the I_sat_min requirement is raised to 634 A (1.1 x fault peak)

trip_temperatures.sensor: metal-tag NTC (B57703M class) on the cold plate between the two hottest positions of each bridge, PELV-insulated probe, hardware comparator into the bridge trip chain (fails "hot": an open NTC must read as over-temperature)
trip_temperatures.limitation: a plate NTC sees only 19 % of a device's own temperature rise (R_th plate / (plate + j-c + insulator)): it detects coolant loss and gross local heating, not a single device's loss excursion - those are caught by DESAT / OC / ZVS supervision in firmware

transformer.sensor: NTC embedded at the winding hot spot by the vendor (reinforced to PELV, IC-08)
transformer.basis: hot-spot design limit 130 C (class F 155 C with margin)

bridge_cross_trip.rule: any trip, RDY/UVLO loss, missing +24 V or an unplugged/unpowered bridge board stops BOTH bridges in hardware within 1 us (common TRIP_N/LATCH between the two bridge logic blocks, pull-down to "fault" on the receiving side); a stopped bridge must never face a switching one for more than one edge
bridge_cross_trip.basis: with one bridge stopped the other drives L against the diode bridge: current rises at up to 97 A/us (1000 V - n x 400 V across 6.5 uH)

worst_case_stresses.module_V_peak_rule: V_bus + L_loop x 0.8 I_off / t_f at the worst feasible point (L_loop 15 nH ASSUMED for the discrete layout, t_f 15 ns at the design R_G,off, hot)

parallel_branch_interface.per_branch_hardware: own port block on both ports per sim/out/port_design/port_spec.json (DAB ports use its <= 135 A variant: HP10NH1GPV160 160 A gPV fuse, TDK HVC43-250A-24MC contactors with hold-closed interlock, 220 ohm precharge, active discharge), own current sensors
parallel_branch_interface.current_sharing: common current/power reference over the CAN-B module bus + per-branch inner current loop on its own I2 sensor; sharing error = sensor gain mismatch (1 % with +/-1 % sensors); without per-branch loops a +/-5 % L_k spread gives +/-4.8 % (dab_control)
parallel_branch_interface.sync: NONE (decision): no hardware carrier-sync line; branch carriers free-running (crystal tolerance only), so ripple at the shared buses beats slowly instead of interleaving
parallel_branch_interface.fault: faulted branch: gates off (driver soft turn-off), its own contactors open; the others keep their own reference; the system controller learns the trip over CAN-B and applies the limit below
signals: CAN-B module bus (ECO-02): references, status, fault report
ENABLE from SYS-IO-AUX safety chain (per branch)

one_branch_fault.system_limit_rule: total reference <= N_alive x P_branch,max(V1, V2) from derating_charge_W; every branch also clamps its own reference to P_branch,max/V2 so a late or wrong CAN reference cannot overload the survivor
one_branch_fault.pcs_must_be_told: new power limit, same CAN frame

verdict_950V: ACCEPTABLE WITH DERATING, cosmic-ray risk NOT quantified: (1) cosmic ray: neither IV3Q12013T4Z nor SG2M014120LJ has a published FIT-vs-DC-voltage curve; 950 V is 79 % of V_DSS. For scale only, Wolfspeed's curves give 0.9 FIT (Gen 4) to 51 FIT (Gen 3) per bridge at 950 V at sea level for 0.3 cm2 per switch - the makers' curve is a release condition. (2) switching SOA: no switching-SOA curve for the discretes; with the assumed 15 nH loop and t_f 15 ns the turn-off current at 950 V must stay below 137 A per switch position (V_DS,peak <= 1200 V); P_max at 950 V: 60.0 kW at V2=900 V, 52.5 kW at 800 V, 35.0 kW at 700 V. (3) the loop inductance is the critical assumption: verify by DPT.
